checks.stdout: REPRODUCED S22-LOCK-1: actual execute/quarantine path holds disposable root flock; SIGQUIT terminates quarantined owner; waitpid confirms signal 3; independent descriptor reacquires flock without positive retirement

blocking_findings.invariant: After execution starts, uncertain positive-current Docker retirement must retain the root-development flock even when evidence/stdout fails or an ordinary termination signal arrives.
blocking_findings.source_argument: execute installs deferred handlers only for SIGHUP, SIGINT and SIGTERM. SIGQUIT retains the normal terminating disposition. quarantine_root_lock catches evidence failures and quarantine_wait catches Python exceptions, but a default SIGQUIT terminates the process outside those handlers; its root-lock descriptor closes without positive retirement. The corrected scratch21 cleanup explicitly protects SIGQUIT as part of its ordinary termination set.

reproducer.output_root: Fresh TemporaryDirectory(prefix='scratch22-review-signal-', dir='/home/holden/mckernel-work/scratch'); removed by its normal context manager after exact child reaping.
steps: Load the exact wrapper through importlib, make a disposable regular root.lock, pipe and fork one child. Set only that child's SIGQUIT disposition to SIG_DFL.

Patch bind_release/preflight to synthetic reviewed objects and acquire_development_lock to open and LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB the disposable file. Patch the two read-only subprocess calls to their expected status receipts. No real Git, root lock, Docker, sudo or build is invoked.

Patch publication to a no-op and run_checked to raise OSError('uncertain disposable execution'); retain the real execute finally, quarantine_root_lock and quarantine_wait. Wrap only quarantine_wait to notify the parent through the pipe before entering the real wait.
Parent waits for quarantine notification and verifies an independently opened descriptor cannot acquire the disposable flock.
Send SIGQUIT only to this exact child PID, waitpid it, verify WIFSIGNALED and WTERMSIG==SIGQUIT, then acquire the same flock successfully through the independent descriptor.
Close descriptors and remove only the fresh disposable temporary directory; fallback cleanup targets only this exact owned test child.
reproducer.observed: Quarantine was entered with real flock held. Child terminated by signal 3. Flock then became available although retirement was never positively proved.

blocking_findings.required_correction: One bounded correction must protect SIGQUIT together with existing HUP/INT/TERM before root-lock/mutation ownership and throughout uncertain quarantine. Add actual disposable child/real-flock regressions for all four signals at the uncertainty/evidence boundary, including failed evidence output and closed stdout. Keep successful safe-release restoration, canonical child signal behavior, original tests and exact failed source evidence. If pthread_sigmask is introduced, do not accidentally pass a changed blocked signal mask to the canonical build child or silently lose deferred-signal reporting.
blocking_findings.author_coordination: Dispatcher notified; author /root/scratch22_build_wrapper accepted the bounded correction. Original exact source/tests must be retained; this review is the initial failed candidate, not authority to execute.

nonblocking_boundary_review.external_authority: --execute is required; bind_release consumes an externally supplied exact digest, scratch22 attempt, execution_count integer 1, fetched-origin commit and exact committed code/tests/adapter/ancestor/release bytes. Independent execution review must have a different author, implementation_ownership=false and a canonical release-payload SHA256.
nonblocking_boundary_review.canonical_review_binding: The payload excludes solely execution_review. The release does not need to include its own digest/commit, so the review-pointer binding avoids a self-hash cycle.
nonblocking_boundary_review.actual_preparation_join: preflight consumes actual preparation schema/status, cleanup/source authority and preparation review, exact preparation controller blobs, target/tree, completed producer Journal terminal and log, prepared request canonical bytes, manifest/owner/driver/disk-wrapper identities and hashes, and the canonical candidate owner's validate path. It does not normalize stdout PASS into preparation authority.
nonblocking_boundary_review.four_flags: derive copies the prepared object and changes only preparation_only, executable, execution_released and release_required; externally reviewed derived canonical SHA256 is mandatory.
nonblocking_boundary_review.namespace: All new candidate/request/materialization/output/evidence/lease/capture paths use scratch22 names. The inherited scratch18 operational-exclusion filename is the canonical owner's ABI slot and remains subject to accepted scratch21 cleanup. No scratch21 request or materialization is replayed.
nonblocking_boundary_review.resources: Limits remain four CPUs 2-5, 12 GiB RAM, MemorySwap equal to RAM (no added swap), 512 tasks and no network. The exact owner/driver/request validation retains jobs<=4 and shared aggregate budget/floors. Wrapper adds no guest concurrency or outer timeout around the authenticated owner.
nonblocking_boundary_review.lock_and_failure_paths: The root lock is acquired before preflight/census and inherited by the execution child through pass_fds. Once build_started is true, absent positive current terminal retirement leads to quarantine before unlock, including start/capture/fsync/terminal writer errors. Quarantine evidence is best effort and no print occurs on that critical hold path. This otherwise coherent structure still has S22-LOCK-1's unprotected SIGQUIT.
nonblocking_boundary_review.retirement_receipt: retirement_proven preserves the predecessor's authenticated current-retirement receipt predicates and retains shared exclusions for separately reviewed cleanup. Failed build status is not accepted as success even when retirement is proved.
